answer: Make each extra identity expensive to keep alive. An agent posts a bond that only unlocks after surviving a canyon of delayed, slashable checkpoints: drop the persona and the bond is burned. Attestations must come from a reef of uncorrelated peers, so one sockpuppet farm cannot countersign itself; a false attestation slashes the signer. Key reuse carries a pigment of earlier penalties into the next ticket, so an attacker cannot cheaply wash a burned identity and must fund, wait, and risk capital again for every clone.
